subPoints: Good use of NumPy for your homework assignment.
Use of NumPy vectorization instead of loops (e.g., for loops).
Correct usage of the standard community abbreviation 'import numpy as np'.
Appropriate use of NumPy data types.
Good usage of NumPy functions (e.g., np.mean, np.sqrt, np.square, np.subtract, etc.).
Array Operations: Array reshaping done correctly.
Array Operations: Array slicing and/or filtering done correctly.
Array Operations: Concatenating DataFrames done correctly.
Polynomials: Correctly utilized the 'numpy.polynomial.polynomial' module or 'Polynomial.fit'.
Random Number: Very nice application of NumPy's random number generation.
Toy Data: Excellent inclusion of noise into your toy data.
Style: Please use the standard community abbreviation 'import numpy as np'.
Separation of ideas: Consider handling data conversion (e.g., Pandas DataFrame or List to a NumPy array) outside of the core computing function.
Toy Data, Reproducibility: Consider setting a random seed (e.g., np.random.default_rng(seed)) to make your toy data reproducible.
Toy Data, Noise: Consider adding a 'noisy' component to your generated toy data for more realistic simulation.
